hero.title: Aspire to Innovate
hero.subtitle: Preparing Students for Leadership in Technology through Digital Skills, Real-World Internships, and Innovation

description: This webinar is designed to inspire and guide tech-enthusiastic students by showcasing how modern technology—especially Digital skills—can be designed, developed, and applied with a strong human-centric approach.
Through real internship experiences, skill journeys, and industry insights, participants will gain clarity on building meaningful tech careers.
